## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (typecheck, lint, tests, build).
- [ ] New or changed code has a fixture test that runs offline.
- [ ] No API keys, cookies or session files in the diff.
- [ ] `docs/tools.md` regenerated with `npm run docs:tools` if tools changed.
- [ ] README, docs or `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behaviour changed.
- [ ] No scraping of IEEE Xplore pages and no bulk downloading.
